page.notes: Reference mark "a" after "habens" in the text; its matching note is not visible in this part of the page. "sispernat" is doubtful (long s and i are hard to separate in the scan). Greek accents and breathings in the Greek words are as far as I could read them; the word after "σωφροσ" is doubtful. "quaq;" and "Atq;" are abbreviations of atque/quaque kept as printed. The "cujusq" abbreviation mark is uncertain. The printed "t" in "finis" and "qui" are read as printed; the "æ-" and "acti-" line-end hyphens are kept as printed.
